final: SELECT COALESCE(ma.college, 'Unknown') AS college, SUM(i.amount) AS total_income, CAST(SUM(i.amount) AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income) AS fraction_of_total FROM income i JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id GROUP BY ma.college UNION ALL SELECT 'Unmatched member' AS college, SUM(i.amount) AS total_income, CAST(SUM(i.amount) AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income) AS fraction_of_total FROM income i LEFT JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id WHERE m.member_id IS NULL HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
